Name: CHAOS_MATCHING_RANK_CONTROL_PARAM_ST
Description: Global parameters that change according to the Deep Night depth

Fields.Name: Cursed Weapon Chance: Uncommon
Fields.Description: Percent chance that an Uncommon custom weapon drop rolls its effects from Attach Effect Tables 4–6 (the cursed set), for lot slots whose Custom Weapon Effect Tables value is neither 0 nor 1. Retail: 25 at every depth.

Fields.Name: Cursed Weapon Chance: Rare
Fields.Description: Percent chance that a Rare custom weapon drop rolls its effects from Attach Effect Tables 4–6 (the cursed set), for lot slots whose Custom Weapon Effect Tables value is neither 0 nor 1. Retail: 40 at every depth.

Fields.Name: Map Challenge Weight: Hidden Map
Fields.Description: Weight of outcome 1 (the map is hidden) in the depth's map-challenge roll, against the other two weights. Retail: 0 at depths 1–2, 10 at 3–5.

Fields.Name: Map Challenge Weight: Hidden Nightlord
Fields.Description: Weight of outcome 2 (the Nightlord is hidden) in the depth's map-challenge roll. Retail: 0 at depths 1–2, 10 at 3–5.

Fields.Name: Map Challenge Weight: None
Fields.Description: Weight of outcome 0 (no map challenge) in the depth's map-challenge roll. Retail: 100 at depths 1–2, 80 at 3–5.

Fields.Name: Cataclysm Weight: 0
Fields.Description: Weight of rolling 0 cataclysm sites at this depth, against the other two weights. Retail: 0 at every depth.

Fields.Name: Cataclysm Weight: 1
Fields.Description: Weight of rolling 1 cataclysm site at this depth. Retail: 50, 50, 25, 10, 5 at depths 1–5.

Fields.Name: Cataclysm Weight: 2
Fields.Description: Weight of rolling 2 cataclysm sites at this depth. Retail: 50, 50, 75, 90, 95 at depths 1–5.
